### Gameday calendar

```{r game-day-cal, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

 # Requires the project's get_games() helper, ggplot2, flexoki, ggtext, tibble,
# tidyr, systemfonts, ragg. Render with the ragg/AGG backend so fonts resolve.

# Fail fast if Roboto Condensed isn't visible to R (restart R after installing).
if (!any(grepl("Roboto Condensed", systemfonts::system_fonts()$family, fixed = TRUE))) {
  stop("Roboto Condensed not found. Restart R after installing, then re-run.")
}

calendar_start <- as.Date("2025-01-01")
calendar_end <- as.Date("2026-12-31")
hire_date <- as.Date("2024-12-11")
season_opener_2026 <- as.Date("2026-08-29")

unc_off_field_events <- tibble::tribble(
  ~date, ~event,
  as.Date("2025-02-28"), "Hard Knocks announced",
  as.Date("2025-03-03"), "Hard Knocks falls through; staff finalized",
  as.Date("2025-04-15"), "Hudson [needs label]",
  as.Date("2025-04-27"), "CBS Sunday Morning interview",
  as.Date("2025-05-09"), "Hudson barred from facility",
  as.Date("2025-07-18"), "Hulu docuseries announced",
  as.Date("2025-10-07"), "Suspension; Hulu docuseries cancelled",
  as.Date("2025-10-16"), "Report: Lombardi in Saudi Arabia",
  as.Date("2026-01-09"), "Petrino hired",
  as.Date("2026-07-27"), "Lombardi placed on leave",
  as.Date("2026-08-06"), "Steve Belichick placed on leave"
) |>
  dplyr::filter(date >= calendar_start, date <= calendar_end) |>
  dplyr::arrange(date)

# raw_games <- dplyr::bind_rows(get_games(2025), get_games(2026)) |>
#  dplyr::filter(homeTeam == "North Carolina" | awayTeam == "North Carolina")

# Conference flag is optional; without it the header reports overall record only.
# if (!"conferenceGame" %in% names(raw_games)) {
#  raw_games$conferenceGame <- NA
# }

# unc_game_days <- raw_games |>
#  dplyr::transmute(
#    date = as.Date(startDate, tz = "America/New_York"),
#    opponent = dplyr::if_else(homeTeam == "North Carolina", awayTeam, homeTeam),
#    is_conference_game = conferenceGame,
#    north_carolina_points = dplyr::if_else(
#      homeTeam == "North Carolina", homePoints, awayPoints
#    ),
#    opponent_points = dplyr::if_else(
#      homeTeam == "North Carolina", awayPoints, homePoints
#    ),
#    game_status = dplyr::case_when(
#      is.na(north_carolina_points) ~ "Upcoming game",
#      north_carolina_points > opponent_points ~ "Win",
#      TRUE ~ "Loss"
#    )
#  ) |>
#  dplyr::filter(date >= calendar_start, date <= calendar_end)

unc_game_days <- readr::read_csv("unc_game_days.csv")

days_since_hire <- as.numeric(season_opener_2026 - hire_date)
games_before_opener <- sum(unc_game_days$date < season_opener_2026)

season_summary <- unc_game_days |>
  dplyr::mutate(season = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    wins = sum(game_status == "Win"),
    losses = sum(game_status == "Loss"),
    upcoming = sum(game_status == "Upcoming game"),
    conf_wins = sum(game_status == "Win" & is_conference_game %in% TRUE),
    conf_losses = sum(game_status == "Loss" & is_conference_game %in% TRUE),
    has_conf_flag = any(!is.na(is_conference_game)),
    opener = min(date),
    games_first_35 = sum(date <= min(date) + 35),
    .by = season
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    record_text = dplyr::case_when(
      upcoming > 0 & wins + losses == 0 ~ paste0(
        "??&ndash;??  <span style='color:#AD8301;'>(only ",
        games_first_35, " games in the first 35 days)</span>"
      ),
      upcoming > 0 ~ paste0(
        wins, "&ndash;", losses, " so far  <span style='color:#AD8301;'>(only ",
        games_first_35, " games in the first 35 days)</span>"
      ),
      has_conf_flag ~ paste0(
        wins, "&ndash;", losses, " overall (",
        conf_wins, "&ndash;", conf_losses, " ACC)"
      ),
      TRUE ~ paste0(wins, "&ndash;", losses, " overall")
    )
  )

block_width <- 8.8    # 7 day columns + gutter
block_height <- 8.6   # 6 week rows + gutter
year_gap <- 3.0

calendar_grid <- tibble::tibble(
  date = seq(calendar_start, calendar_end, by = "day")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
    month_index = as.integer(format(date, "%m")),
    month_label = format(date, "%B"),
    mday = as.integer(format(date, "%d")),
    weekday_index = (as.POSIXlt(date)$wday + 6L) %% 7L + 1L  # Mon = 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    first_weekday = weekday_index[mday == 1L],
    .by = c(year, month_index)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    week_of_month = (mday + first_weekday - 2L) %/% 7L + 1L,
    block_row = (month_index - 1L) %/% 3L + 1L,
    block_col = (month_index - 1L) %% 3L + 1L,
    year_offset = year - min(year),
    x_left = (year_offset * 3L + block_col - 1L) * block_width + year_offset * year_gap,
    x = x_left + weekday_index,
    y = (block_row - 1L) * block_height + week_of_month
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(unc_game_days, by = dplyr::join_by(date)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(unc_off_field_events, by = dplyr::join_by(date)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    game_status = dplyr::coalesce(game_status, "No game"),
    day_text_color = dplyr::if_else(game_status == "Loss", "light", "dark"),
    is_opener = date == season_opener_2026
  )

month_blocks <- calendar_grid |>
  dplyr::distinct(year, month_index, month_label, block_row, x_left) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_title = (block_row - 1L) * block_height - 1.7,
    y_header = (block_row - 1L) * block_height - 0.6
  )

weekday_headers <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  month_blocks |> dplyr::select(x_left, y_header),
  tibble::tibble(
    weekday_index = 1:7,
    weekday_label = c("Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa", "Su")
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = x_left + weekday_index)

  year_headers <- calendar_grid |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = min(x_left) + 1, .by = year) |>
  dplyr::left_join(season_summary, by = dplyr::join_by(year == season)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    y = -4.4,
    label = paste0(
      "<span style='font-size:15pt;color:#100F0F;'><b>", year, "</b></span>",
      "<span style='font-size:15pt;color:#CECDC3;'><b> | </b></span>",
      "<span style='font-size:15pt;color:#6F6E69;'><b>", record_text, "</b></span>"
    )
  )

y_top <- -6.2
y_bottom <- max(calendar_grid$y) + 1.2

unc_calendar_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(calendar_grid, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    ggplot2::aes(fill = game_status),
    width = 0.92,
    height = 0.92,
    color = "#FFFCF0",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, !is.na(event)),
    ggplot2::aes(color = "Off-field event"),
    width = 0.92,
    height = 0.92,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_opener),
    ggplot2::aes(color = "2026 season opener"),
    width = 1.06,
    height = 1.06,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, day_text_color == "dark"),
    ggplot2::aes(label = mday),
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    size = 2.1,
    color = "#100F0F"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, day_text_color == "light"),
    ggplot2::aes(label = mday),
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    size = 2.1,
    color = "#FFFCF0"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = month_blocks,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x_left + 1, y = y_title, label = month_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.2,
    color = "#100F0F"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = weekday_headers,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y_header, label = weekday_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    size = 2.1,
    color = "#878580"
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = year_headers,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0, "lines")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "No game" = "#E6E4D9",
      "Win" = "#56A0D3",
      "Loss" = "#1F5A7A",
      "Upcoming game" = "#C6DEEE"
    ),
    breaks = c("Win", "Loss", "Upcoming game"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Off-field event" = "#AF3029",
      "2026 season opener" = "#D0A215"
    ),
    breaks = c("Off-field event", "2026 season opener"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(fill = NA, linewidth = 1.1)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(limits = c(y_bottom, y_top)) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 1)) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "The Belichick Era, So Far",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Belichick was officially hired on December 11, 2024. By the ",
      "<span style='color:#AD8301;'>**2026 opener**</span> on ",
      format(season_opener_2026, "%B %d"), ", he will have been on the job ",
      days_since_hire, " days. <br> 13 of those are **game days**, and the rest spent working through a steady run of ",
      "<span style='color:#AF3029;'>**off-field events**</span>."
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Days in red mark off-field headlines: staff placed on administrative or medical leave, ",
      "a canceled HBO Hard Knocks series and Hulu docuseries, a book release and awkward CBS Sunday Morning interview, <br> and staff changes.<br>",
      "<br>",
      "Data via collegefootballdata.com and chapelboro.com | ",
      "cfbtxt.com  | Viz by Chris at Bless your Chart"
    )
  ) +
  flexoki::theme_flexoki_light() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed"),
    plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 19),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
      color = "#6F6E69",
      size = 11,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(
      color = "#878580",
      size = 8,
      hjust = 0,
      lineheight = 1.4,
      margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)
    ),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "left",
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 14, 12, 14)
  )

unc_calendar_plot

ggplot2::ggsave(
  "unc_belichick_calendar.png",
  plot = unc_calendar_plot,
  width = 9.5, 
  height = 9.5, 
  dpi = 150
)
```
